newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac sets $157.6 mln REMICs 1913, 1914.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac sets $157.6 mln REMICs 1913, 1914.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp (FHLMC or Freddie Mac) said it issued $157.6 million of Real Estate Mortgage Conduit (REMIC) securities.
REMIC series 1913, a $7.6 million re-REMIC, is underwritten by Salomon Inc, Freddie Mac said. The issue priced November 1 and has a settlement date of November 29, the agency said.

REMIC series 1914, made up of $150 million of 30-year singled-family fixed-rate mortgages, is underwritten by Lehman Brothers, FHLMC said. It has a settlement date of December 27 and a coupon of 7.5 percent.
